responsibility: This header is the main declaration interface for the MIPS backend implementation in mips.cc and related files. It defines key MIPS-specific enums and data categories such as symbol contexts/types, loadgp styles, call kinds, and split policies, and it declares the large set of public backend helper routines for addressing, symbol handling, builtins, prologue/epilogue emission, vector expansion, scheduling, microMIPS helpers, and frame-header optimization that other MIPS source files and generated code rely on.
